No live data, no real signatures.

/timesheets.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (grid, entry, bulk and phone layout inspected; 820/844/1180 by the no-overflow checks); ready and empty states, and a refused refresh that keeps the grid (a server outage is retried automatically by the page's own read, so it is not a failed state). NEC and salaried rosters, approved leave laid over as 8 hours and pending overtime shown as Pending, entering a day, quick add (the role's normal shift), quick remove, keyboard fill across two days, bulk entry for the weekdays, copy-previous asking before it replaces, adding a person by hand, per-period notes, the Excel workbook (read back: values, the Actual and 1.5x formulas), and the scan import dialog opening. No live data; PDF and Excel were not opened in their apps.
/timesheets.note: Presentation moved to the shared system; payroll rules (calcTotals), merging, fill and write rules, the hooks and the exports are unchanged and keep their own tests. The user's in-progress edits to those files were left as they were.

/employees.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (cards, normalise and phone screenshots inspected; 820/844/1180 by the no-overflow checks); ready, empty, failed-load and create states; status tiles as filters, search, section collapse, archived people on request, cards grouped by section and trade and the table, detail (no offence records shown), edit with a field error and a cleared date, delete with a refusal, the organised roster export and the registry download (both produce a workbook), and the roster clean-up with a refused batch. No live data.
/employees.note: Register pattern with section and trade groups. The form is one scrolling form (the old four tabs hid errors on other tabs).

/leaves.scope: Rendered with a fixture session (admin) and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (1440 screenshots inspected; 820/844/1180 by the no-overflow checks); ready, empty and failed-load states; filters including the overlapping date range, table selection and bulk approve gate, detail, edit with validation, apply with a refused save, delete with confirmation, summary. The signature step was opened and dismissed; an actual signed approval was not driven. No live data.
/leaves.note: Register of leave requests (also where /leave-management now redirects). The shared ApprovalGate shell was rebuilt on Dialog (focus trap, Escape, dialog role).

/standby.note: Standby module: weekly board and month calendar over standby_rotations and duty_rotations with crew, call/WhatsApp actions, covers holding in place of absent members, leave warnings, and duty overrides from duty_roster.

/test-homepage.scope: Temporary design concept; route spec only renders the sections, no fixture browser run.
/test-homepage.note: TEMPORARY. Frontend-only concept, not linked from any nav; delete the folder to remove it.

No live data.
/near_miss.note: Register table with section tiles as filters, detail dialog, add/edit/delete; failed save keeps input; failed load is not shown as empty. Inline row expansion dropped (the detail dialog shows the same fields).

/safety_complaints.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, including the Analytics tab at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions; keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data.

Analytics still reads the filtered list. Inline row expansion dropped (detail dialog shows the same fields).

/work_stoppage.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, including the issue form with an action at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions; keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data.
/work_stoppage.note: Cards and table, tiles for action status, detail dialog listing corrective actions, add/edit/delete; failed save keeps input; a record with an unrecognised section renders instead of crashing. The form is one scrolling dialog (the Details/Action plan/Summary tabs were dropped so validation errors are never hidden on another tab); progress shows above the action list. Inline row expansion and Expand/Collapse all dropped.

/vfl.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, including the observation form at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions; keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data.
/vfl.note: Cards and table, status tiles as filters, behaviour filter, detail dialog with inline status change (optimistic, reverted with the reason on failure), add/edit/delete; records with a bad time, missing technique or unrecognised section render. The form is one scrolling dialog (tabs dropped); the Status field shows only when editing because a new observation is always saved as submitted (it was previously shown on create and ignored). Safe/Unsafe/Actions tiles became a behaviour filter with counts and a count line.

/sheq_inspection.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, including the edit form with findings and photos at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions; keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data.
/sheq_inspection.note: Cards and table, section/status filters, detail dialog with findings, photos and sign-off, add/edit/delete. The form is one scrolling dialog (tabs dropped); per-finding errors; completed date disabled until a finding is closed. Photo upload still uses the legacy PhotoUpload component as an interim bridge (uploading was not exercised: it needs a live storage endpoint). Finding-status tiles are informational, not filters, because they count findings while the list shows inspections.

/sheq.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, every tab at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions (period filter, weekly targets, notes, analysis); keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data. The analysis call was exercised against a mocked response, not the real AI service.
/sheq.note: Collapsible sections became tabs (Overview, Weekly targets, Modules, Analytics, Analysis, Notes); tiles link to their modules. Two data corrections: (1) near-miss records have no status or severity, so the old Resolved/Open donut and 'NM resolution' bar, which fell back to invented 70/30 figures, are gone and only the section split is shown; (2) the safety score now averages only the measures that have records and shows 'No score' for an empty period, where it used to show 100 'Good standing' (near miss always contributed a fixed 100). Weekly targets and notes stay in this browser's local storage and are labelled as device-only. A chart legend made the module bar chart draw no bars, so it was removed.

/pto.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, including the form's Yes/No rows at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions; keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data.
/pto.note: Cards and table, status tiles as filters, high-risk filter with a count, detail dialog with reasons, remedies, risk assessment and actions, inline status change (optimistic, reverted with the reason on failure), add/edit/delete. A legacy record missing every nested group (and an unrecognised section) renders and opens in the editor instead of crashing. The form is one scrolling dialog (tabs dropped); Yes/No radios became segmented toggles and the check lists use the shared checkbox. The Report status field shows only when editing because a new report is always saved as submitted (it was shown on create and ignored). Inline row expansion dropped.

/pachedu.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, including the checklist at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions; keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data.
/pachedu.note: Cards and table, status tiles as filters, high-risk filter (serious injury, fatality or environmental impact), detail dialog with inline status change, add/edit/delete, the full referral checklist and Shona/Ndebele prompts kept. Summary figures are now computed from the complete (paged) list; the page no longer reads /stats/overview, so statistics and register share one failure mode. A legacy record with an unknown section and no lists renders. The Status field shows only when editing because a new observation is always saved as submitted. Inline expansion and the hand-rolled action menus dropped.

/requisitions.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API (in the backend's real snake_case shape with nested items) at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, including the item form at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions; keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data.
/requisitions.note: Table with status/priority tiles as filters, detail dialog with the item table and total, Requisitions/Analytics tabs (status count and value, priority, section split, value summary, each with a text alternative), add/edit/delete with a repeatable item section and a live total. A failed load used to leave an empty list under a toast ('No requisitions'); it now shows 'could not be loaded'. A duplicate requisition number is rejected by the backend and shown inside the dialog with the input kept. Delete is manager-only on the backend and the confirmation says so. Employee and equipment lookups feed suggestion lists and say so if the equipment list fails. The list route takes no limit, so it cannot be paged and depends on the database cap of 1000.

/admin.scope: Rendered with a fixture admin session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions (role change, reset-password confirmation, reactivation, invite); keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data and no real accounts: nothing was invited, deactivated or reset.
/admin.note: User directory table with role tiles as filters, a Manage dialog (role, deactivate with confirmation, reactivate, reset password with confirmation, failures shown inside the dialog), invite dialog with the backend's error shown and input kept, role guide. Permission rules preserved: a super admin manages anyone, an admin cannot manage a super admin or themselves, and an admin is not offered the Super Admin role (or Admin, when inviting). The page only fetches users once the caller is confirmed an admin; signed-out visitors see 'Sign in required' instead of a spinner. The backend enforces the same rules; this was not run against it.

/noticeboard.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820, 390 and 320 px (screenshots inspected, with and without the shell's active-notices popup, and the form at 320); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions including a real file pick through the upload endpoint (mocked); keyboard and dialog focus where applicable. No live data and no real storage upload.
/noticeboard.note: Pinned and other notices as cards or a table, status/pinned tiles as filters, server-side filters and a debounced search (one request per finished word), detail dialog with attachment thumbnails and download links, optimistic pin with revert, archive-all-expired and unpin-all now ask first, hide-expired stays a view-only toggle, add/edit/delete with multi-file attachment upload (failures shown in place and the save waits for uploads). Tiles count the current view and say so when filters are on. The list route is unbounded (CrudRouter) and not paged. The shell's active-notices popup was rebuilt on the UI system and moved to the bottom (it covered the top bar and page title on phones and the header actions on desktop).

/compressors.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (screenshots inspected; 844 and 1180 by the no-overflow checks only); ready, empty and failed-load states; the page's own interactions (reading validation and save, day change, status change, record a service, analytics section failure, add). No live data.
/compressors.note: Daily reading cards and table, services, analytics, management. Previous readings reload per day and a failed history is stated; analytics sections report their own failures. Recording a service sets the running hours to the interval (existing behaviour, now confirmed first).

No live data.
/shifts.note: Planning grid pattern. The 4-week schedule is a real table with a sticky first column and cells that state their meaning in words.

/documents.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (home, category and folder screenshots inspected; 820/844/1180 by the no-overflow checks); home with search, the server cap and a failed search; category with built-in and custom folders and top-level files; folder cards and table with filters, star, preview, edit details, bulk delete with a refused item, upload with a refused file, and a failed folder load with retry. No live data, no real storage, no real upload.
/documents.note: Hub pattern. Files saved at a category's top level are now listed; bulk delete confirms; deleting a folder is refused while it holds files (the server deletes only the folder row).

/services.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (cards, sheet, detail and import screenshots inspected; 820/844/1180 by the no-overflow checks); ready, empty, failed-load and create states; status tiles as filters, search, cards, table and sheet, the detail with per-stage saving (validation, a refused save, reopen with confirmation), attachments (list, attach, failed load), edit, delete with a refusal, spreadsheet import with a skipped row, an unrecognised column and a refused row, and a scan pre-filling the form. No live data, no real OCR or storage.
/services.note: Register pattern with a staged approval detail. Each approval stage now saves on its own with an explicit button (it was a debounced auto-save that could lose the last change). The backend list is now paged (uncommitted, not deployed).

/overtime.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (cards, detail, patterns and weekly screenshots inspected; 820/844/1180 by the no-overflow checks); ready, empty, failed-load and create states; status tiles as filters, search, month shortcuts and the employee scope, cards and table, the bulk bar and the signature step (opened and dismissed, nothing approved), detail, edit (hours-to-times switch, refused save), delete with a refusal, bulk entry with a refused person, insights (overview, analytics, patterns with the heatmap, causes, a failed re-run), and the weekly summary with its Excel download. /overtime.note: Register pattern with three tabs. The largest page: 2789 lines became a page of about 200 plus 17 focused files.

/employees-preview.note: Retired sandbox (owner decision 4 Oct 2026); its components and grouping module were deleted, the register's own grouping is now the single one.

/artisan-timesheets.note: Dense grid kept (frozen panes, copy-down) on the shared system's controls. Signature capture still uses the shared SignaturePad.

/spares.scope: Rendered with a fixture session and mocked API at 1440, 820 and 390 px (cards and requisition screenshots inspected; 820/844/1180 by the no-overflow checks); ready, empty, failed-load and create states; stock tiles as filters, search, the category panel, favourites, cards and table, detail, edit (numbers sent as numbers, categories kept), delete with confirmation and a refusal, a refused add that keeps the typing, and the requisition builder (adding a part, an incomplete line flagged, save, load, delete, PDF download).
